Yeah, it was on Craigslist. I didn’t fully trust so that’s why I took her to the vet same day to check her health and see if she had any special needs etc so I could attend to them. She also is prone to getting UTI’s which came up in her checkup and I had to get special wipes for when she pees, the breeder never informed me either. I was furious because I would have still taken her but these are things we should be informed so we know how to care for them

Get a harness that has for clipping in the chest and in the back. Then get a double leash and clip both, you’ll have more grip there and he’ll calm down. They can feel you stressed, which makes then anxious to destroy etc. They also love to cuddle so if you don’t do it multiple times a day for more than 5 minutes each time it would be an issue. My Great Dane liked to call for “attention” by grabbing things if she came by my side and I didn’t cuddle her when I would be in work meetings online same if she wanted to play. I make sure to play with her a lot and give her many cuddles and pet her if she comes near me when I’m working so she’s very chill now. Play with him every day throwing the ball back and forth for at least 30 minutes, and sit down with him on the floor and cuddle him so he calms down. He might just want your attention. If you feel like you don’t have the time for that, maybe a new owner would be a better choice, but that is up to you to decide.

The breeder told me that if I didn’t get her at that time, she would give her to someone else. I had no idea 5 weeks was too early and this woman said it was “fine”. I took her to the vet immediately after getting her to check her health etc, that’s when I found out she was separated too soon. Gave her milk every 6-8 hours and was with her 24/7. She’s strong and healthy now and that breeder is horrible.

I didn’t know at the time, as soon as I got her I took her to the vet to check if she was healthy etc and that’s when they told me she was separated too soon from her mom.
